content.short: Trustware lets applications and institutions accept deposits from any blockchain.
content.description: Trustware handles the deposit side of cross-chain complexity, letting an application accept funds from whichever network a user holds them on without building bridging into its own product. For exchanges and fintechs, deposit friction is a direct conversion problem, which is why this narrow slice of infrastructure has attracted several vendors.
content.meta: Trustware lets applications and institutions accept blockchain deposits from any network.
